pipeline: backfill yahoo_auctions_jp closed comps by HKT sale date
daily median JPY→HKD + volume; preserve HK asks + images
recompute movers / liquidity / spreads from history
thumbnails: official TCGdex / pokemon-card.com art only (never auction photos)
series MERGE-by-date + catalog persist (no full re-scrape)

carousell_hk.note: HK asks; HKCardLink fallback if Cloudflare blocks Carousell
carousell_hk.fallback_note: Carousell skipped: None; using HKCardLink catalog

meta.image_source_note: Dashboard thumbnails from TCGdex card faces or pokemon-card.com product art; Yahoo listing photos are never used. Local files in data/images/ are reused across runs.
